# Unwavering Resolve
## Scripture
"Consider him who endured from sinners such hostility against himself so that you may not grow weary or fainthearted." – Hebrews 12:3
## Reflection
As warriors of Christ, we often face opposition and hostility from those around us. It's easy to become discouraged and lose our resolve when faced with adversity. But we must remember that our Lord Jesus Christ faced even greater resistance and hostility, and yet He remained steadfast in His faith and commitment to His mission.

We are called to emulate this unwavering resolve in our own lives. When faced with challenges and criticism, we must draw on the strength of Christ and press on, even when it's hard. This doesn't mean we'll never feel weary or fainthearted; but it means we won't let those feelings define us. Instead, we'll find our strength in Christ and trust in His promises to see us through.

## Daily Challenge
"Do 20 squats while declaring your unwavering resolve to serve Christ, no matter what."
